concepts.name: Counselling Frontend SPA
concepts.summary: A React + TypeScript single-page application serving both askers and consultants of the ORISO counselling platform. Everything a user sees lives here: registration, the session inbox, chat, calls, bookings, profile and legal pages. The app boots from src/initApp.tsx into src/components/app/app.tsx, which mounts routing, global providers and tenant theming.

concepts.name: Application Structure, Routing and Global State
concepts.summary: Routing is table-driven: RouterConfig.tsx assembles route definitions, Routing.tsx renders them, AuthenticatedApp.tsx guards the logged-in area and SessionsZone.tsx hosts the session workspace; feature areas add their own route modules such as booking.routes.ts. There is no Redux — state is a stack of context providers assembled in src/globalState/state.tsx (user, tenant, locale, sessions, Matrix client, calls, encryption).

concepts.name: REST API Client Layer
concepts.summary: Every backend call goes through one thin function per endpoint under src/api (about 129 files, apiXxx.ts naming). src/api/fetchData.ts is the shared fetch wrapper with FetchErrorWithOptions, and src/resources/scripts/endpoints.ts holds the URL constants. Generated backend types live in src/generated/userservice.d.ts and src/generated/agencyservice.d.ts.

concepts.name: Registration and Agency Selection
concepts.summary: The asker onboarding funnel under src/components/registration: a stepper (registrationSteps.ts, RegistrationStepper.tsx) walks through topic selection, postcode/agency selection (AgencySelection.tsx, useAgenciesForRegistration.ts), demographic input and account data. Field-level rules live in registrationDataValidation.ts and registrationValidationFields.ts; state is held by RegistrationProvider.tsx.

concepts.name: Consent Gates and Legal Texts
concepts.summary: Legal texts are fetched, not bundled: src/api/apiGetConsentText.ts and src/api/apiGetDepartmentLegal.ts pull tenant and department texts, which LegalContentRenderer.tsx and LegalTextReader.tsx render after legalHtmlSanitizer.ts sanitises them. Consent acceptance in registration is gated by consentAcceptance.ts and DataProtectionConsentLabel.tsx; anonymous askers pass AnonymousConsentGate.tsx.

concepts.name: Anonymous Asker Identity and Pseudonyms
concepts.summary: Askers can appear under a generated pseudonym rather than a real name. src/utils/anonName/engine.ts and src/utils/pseudonymGenerator.ts produce the names, PseudonymCard.tsx and AnimalAvatar.tsx present them, and anonymousConsentInvariant.ts plus isAnonymousAsker.ts encode the rules for when an asker counts as anonymous. Live anonymous chat is handled by src/components/anonymousChat/AnonymousChat.tsx.

concepts.name: Matrix-backed Real-time Messaging
concepts.summary: Chat runs on Matrix, not on a bespoke socket protocol. MatrixClientService creates and owns the client, matrixClientRegistry.ts keeps the singleton, MatrixLiveEventBridge turns Matrix timeline events into app events, and ChatTransportService is the send/receive facade used by the UI. Timeline rendering is normalised by src/utils/matrixTimelineEventFormatter.ts.

concepts.name: End-to-End Encryption and Key Management
concepts.summary: Room encryption state, key backup and device handling are separated into dedicated services: matrixCrypto.ts, matrixKeyBackupService.ts (with CryptoUnavailableError / InvalidRecoveryKeyError), matrixDeviceDehydration.ts, matrixDeviceIsolation.ts and matrixRoomHistoryKeyTransfer.ts. The user-facing side is EncryptionSettings and the SubscriptionKeyLost / MasterKeyLost surfaces; ADR-019 documents the silent key-backup setup.

concepts.name: Session Inbox and Classification
concepts.summary: Consultants work from a session list: SessionsList.tsx renders it, sessionClassification.ts and sessionToolbarFilters.ts decide which bucket (enquiry, ongoing, archive) a session falls into, and sessionUnread.ts / sessionsListUnreadChip drive unread markers. Session data is loaded through apiGetConsultantSessionList.ts and apiGetAskerSessionList.ts and held by SessionsDataProvider.

concepts.name: Message Composer and Attachments
concepts.summary: The composer under src/components/messageSubmitInterface is TipTap-based (TipTapComposer.tsx) with its own error boundary, audience selection (audienceOptions.ts, audienceSelectorVisibility.ts) and file drop/paste handling (composerFileDropPaste.ts, attachmentHelpers.ts). Uploads go through apiMatrixUpload.ts and mediaUploadHelpers.ts; unsent text survives in draftStore.ts and apiUserDrafts.ts.

concepts.name: Video Calls via Element Call and LiveKit
concepts.summary: Calls are embedded rather than reimplemented: useElementCallWidget.ts loads the Element Call widget, OrisoWidgetDriver.ts and orisoWidgetCapabilities.ts negotiate the widget API, MatrixGroupCallService and LiveKitService handle group-call and SFU concerns, and CallManager coordinates call lifecycle. ADR-018 describes the Matryoshka embedding; the Node proxy mints LiveKit tokens.

concepts.name: Bookings and Appointments
concepts.summary: The bookings area under src/containers/bookings renders event lists (booked, cancelled, expired), calendar integration and availability; data comes from apiGetAppointmentsServiceBookingEventsByUserId.ts and apiGetConsultantAppointments.ts. Appointments are exportable as ICS via src/utils/appointmentIcs.ts, and a Cal.com embed path exists alongside a legacyVideoAppointmentRemoval test.

concepts.name: Tenant Theming and the M3 Colour Scheme
concepts.summary: Colours are derived, not hand-written: src/utils/theme/orisoScheme.ts builds the Material-3 scheme from seeds, applyTenantTheme.ts writes the CSS variables, and useTenantTheming.ts / TenantThemingLoader.tsx apply the theme a tenant delivers through apiGetTenantTheming.ts. Branding assets are resolved by resolveTenantMediaUrl.ts and applyBrandingFavicon.ts.

concepts.name: Internationalisation and Locale Handling
concepts.summary: src/i18n.ts configures the catalogues, LocaleProvider.tsx and LocaleContext.tsx expose the active locale, and i18nSupportedLanguages.ts plus normalizePreferredLanguage.ts constrain what a tenant may offer. mergeWeblateCatalogue.ts merges externally supplied translations over the bundled ones, with translationFallback.ts and i18nCatalogueGuard.ts guarding missing keys.

concepts.name: Storybook, Component Tests and E2E Harnesses
concepts.summary: The repo carries four test surfaces: Storybook stories (hundreds of *.stories.tsx, configured in .storybook/main.ts and preview.tsx with an ORISO scheme decorator), colocated unit tests, Playwright smoke and cross-browser specs under playwright/, and Cypress e2e under cypress/ with a stubbed matrix-js-sdk. Storybook also hosts the email design kit under src/emails/stories.

flows.name: Asker Registers → First Enquiry Sent
flows.summary: Registration.tsx drives the steps from registrationSteps.ts → topic and agency chosen via TopicSelection.tsx and AgencySelection.tsx (agencies from useAgenciesForRegistration.ts) → account data validated by registrationDataValidation.ts and consent captured by consentAcceptance.ts → apiPostRegistration.ts creates the account → autoLogin.ts signs the user in → apiSendEnquiry.ts posts the first enquiry into the new session.

flows.name: Consultant Logs In → Opens a Session
flows.summary: Login.tsx authenticates against Keycloak, getKeycloakAccessToken.ts and accessSessionCookie.ts persist the tokens (refreshKeycloakAccessToken.ts renews them) → AuthenticatedApp.tsx mounts the logged-in shell → apiGetConsultantSessionList.ts fills SessionsDataProvider → SessionsList.tsx shows the classified inbox → SessionView.tsx and SessionStream.tsx render the selected conversation.

flows.name: App Boots → Matrix Client Ready
flows.summary: authenticatedMatrixLoginData.ts derives the Matrix credentials from the logged-in session, getMatrixAccessToken.ts and matrixAccountStorage.ts supply and persist them → MatrixClientService starts the client and matrixClientRegistry.ts publishes the singleton into MatrixClientContext → MatrixLiveEventBridge subscribes to timeline events → useMatrixReady.tsx lets components wait for a usable client.

flows.name: User Sends a Message with an Attachment
flows.summary: TipTapComposer.tsx captures the text (draft kept by draftStore.ts) → composerFileDropPaste.ts and attachmentHelpers.ts accept the file, mediaContentScanner.ts screens it → apiMatrixUpload.ts uploads via the Matrix media endpoint, matrixEncryptedAttachment.ts encrypts it in encrypted rooms → apiSendMatrixAttachmentMessage.ts or apiSendMessage.ts posts the event → MessageItemComponent.tsx and MessageAttachment.tsx render it in the timeline.

flows.name: Consultant Starts a Video Call in a Session
flows.summary: CallProvider.tsx holds the call state and CallManager.ts drives the lifecycle → MatrixGroupCallService prepares the Matrix group call → useElementCallWidget.ts embeds the Element Call widget, with OrisoWidgetDriver.ts brokering the widget API and orisoWidgetCapabilities.ts declaring the allowed capabilities → LiveKitService handles the SFU media path → GroupCallWidget.tsx and FloatingCallWidget.tsx render the call surface.

flows.name: App Loads → Tenant Branding Applied
flows.summary: TenantProvider.tsx resolves the tenant (localTenantCookie.ts for local overrides) → apiGetTenantTheming.ts fetches colours and assets → useTenantTheming.ts feeds them into orisoScheme.ts, which derives the full Material-3 scheme → applyTenantTheme.ts writes the CSS custom properties and applyBrandingFavicon.ts swaps the favicon → TenantThemingLoader.tsx blocks rendering until the theme is in place.

flows.name: User Opens a Legal Text → Sanitised HTML Shown
flows.summary: LegalLinks.tsx and LegalLinkButton.tsx offer the entry points, useLegalLinkContent.ts picks the right kind → apiGetDepartmentLegal.ts / useDepartmentLegal.ts or apiGetConsentText.ts fetch the tenant text → legalHtmlSanitizer.ts strips unsafe markup and legalHeadingAnchors.ts builds the anchor list → LegalContentRenderer.tsx and LegalTextReader.tsx display it, with LegalLinkModal.tsx as the overlay variant.

flows.name: User Recovers Encrypted History After Re-login
flows.summary: On a fresh device matrixCrypto.ts reports missing keys and useMatrixDecryptionFailures.ts surfaces undecryptable events → SubscriptionKeyLost.tsx / MasterKeyLostMessage.tsx prompt the user → EncryptionSettings drives matrixKeyBackupService.ts, which validates the recovery key (InvalidRecoveryKeyError) and restores the backup, with pendingRecoveryKeyStore.ts holding the in-flight setup → matrixRoomHistoryKeyTransfer.ts re-shares room history keys.

flows.name: Consultant Accepts an Enquiry → First Reply Sequence
flows.summary: A new enquiry appears in the list (refetchEnquiryList.ts, EnquiryFilterChips.tsx) → AcceptAssign.tsx calls apiEnquiryAcceptance.ts or apiAcceptAnonymousEnquiry.ts → the asker-side ErstantwortSequence.tsx plays the first-response experience built from erstantwortCatalogue.ts and erstantwortResolve.ts → NotificationChoiceCard.tsx and SaveCredentialsCard.tsx capture how the asker wants to be reached and whether credentials are stored.

flows.name: Consultant Hands a Case Over to a Colleague
flows.summary: caseHandoverHelpers.ts prepares the handover payload and caseHandoverPrivacy.ts decides what may be shown about the client → apiCaseHandover.ts and apiSessionAssign.ts perform the transfer → CaseHandoverCurtain.tsx covers the session while the handover is pending and CaseHandoverClientCards.tsx summarises the case → caseHandoverPreviewGate.ts controls what the notifications centre may preview about it.

layerDescriptions.Domain Concepts: The enriched business view of the counselling frontend — registration, consent, messaging, calls, bookings and theming — layered on top of the deterministic file graph.
layerDescriptions.API Layer: The src/api directory: one thin typed function per backend endpoint plus the shared fetchData.ts wrapper and the endpoint URL constants.
layerDescriptions.Service Layer: Long-lived browser-side services under src/services — Matrix client, crypto and key backup, call and LiveKit management, drafts and storage hygiene.
layerDescriptions.UI Layer: React components, containers and Storybook stories under src/components, src/containers and src/features that render registration, sessions, chat, calls, bookings, profile and legal screens.
layerDescriptions.Core: Application bootstrap and cross-cutting wiring: src/initApp.tsx, the app shell and routing, global state providers, hooks and i18n setup.
layerDescriptions.Utility Layer: Pure helpers under src/utils — theming and M3 scheme derivation, Matrix event formatting, date and notification helpers, pseudonym generation and observability.
layerDescriptions.Configuration Layer: Build and runtime configuration: webpack/config files, runtimeConfig.ts, environment handling and the Node proxy configuration.
layerDescriptions.Test Layer: Test scaffolding kept outside the colocated *.test.ts files, such as the shared jsdom polyfills and test utilities.
